decisions.target_truth: Broaden the physical center beyond a waist-worn strip to a band/continuous strip or loop, covering seat belt and conveyor belt naturally. Keep geographic/industrial/green belt as a region shaped or conceptualized as a band, and preserve tighten one's belt as a phrase.

Keep literal bench=long seat as L1, but undo the v4 merge that collapses legal the bench=judge/judges/court and sports bench=reserve players into the literal-seat sense. Legal bench is learner-worthy as a distinct branch; sports bench/bench a player may remain lower but semantically distinct.

Use one physical bend=make/become curved center plus noun bend=curved part, then a clear abstract extension bend/yield to pressure and high-value bend the rules=relax/alter rules. Remove duplicate Core sense_id and avoid treating separate historical transitivity variants as separate semantic objects.

Keep physical beneath=under/lower than, but include high-value abstract extensions: hidden beneath the surface, below in rank/value, or unworthy of attention/dignity (beneath notice, beneath one's dignity). Current owner is physical-only.
Keep beneficial=helpful/favorable, producing a good effect, with beneficial to/effect. Current single center and family relation are acceptable.

Keep noun benefit=advantage/help, verb benefit sb/sth=help, verb benefit from=get advantage, and lower welfare/payment and charity-event senses. Rebind benefit from away from the noun benefit sense; it belongs to the intransitive verb branch and should exist as one learner object.
Keep benevolent=kind, well-meaning and generous/helpful. Current merge of charitable generosity into the broader kindness center is semantically sound.

Keep medical benign=nonmalignant and ordinary benign=gentle/harmless/favorable/kind. Correct the medical definition: benign does not mean universally harmless, nonrecurrent or nonprogressive; define it by nonmalignant biological behavior rather than absolute clinical safety.

Restore Active beside=at the side of/next to as the ordinary L1 sense. Current v4 state has zero Active senses despite a correct Core. Keep beside distinct from besides; old 'in addition to/apart from' beside uses should not replace the modern spatial center.

Keep preposition besides=in addition to/apart from and adverb besides=furthermore/in addition. Revise the Current relations that state besides is interchangeable with also/too: they overlap semantically but differ in discourse function and typical position, so the boundary must be probabilistic rather than absolute.

Keep adjective/adverb best and noun the best/best effort, plus at best. Rebind do one's best to the noun 'maximum effort' branch; do not attach it to the adverb sense. Separate noun best=best person/thing/part from best=maximum effort so examples such as the best of both worlds are not used to define effort.

Keep noun/verb wager and the common conversational extension I bet (that)...=I am confident/I suppose. Bet on and bet sb that... structures are learner-worthy and current presentation merge is acceptable.

Use one disloyalty/betrayal center for betray a person/country/trust rather than overlapping separate senses, and keep a distinct high-value reveal branch betray a secret/feeling/sign=disclose or unintentionally reveal.
Keep comparative adjective/adverb better, noun better/something better, low verb better=improve/surpass, and high-value constructions had better and be better off. Current hierarchy is acceptable.

Define between by an intermediate relationship among distinct identifiable endpoints/participants, not a hard 'exactly two things' rule. Between can be used with more than two distinct individuals/items; preserve spatial, temporal, quantitative and shared/distributed uses under that relational center.
Single noun beverage=drink/drinkable liquid is correct and sufficiently represented.
Keep beware=be cautious/on guard, especially beware of sb/sth. Current single center is sufficient.
Keep bewilder=confuse completely/leave someone very puzzled or unsure what to do. Remove the unjustified restriction 'confused emotionally'; the confusion need not be emotional in cause or domain.

Organize beyond around crossing/passing a boundary or limit, with physical 'on the far side of' and abstract 'outside/exceeding a range, control, understanding, doubt, etc.' as linked applications. Rebind beyond doubt/control to the abstract-limit branch and avoid duplicate generic beyond + sth objects.

Keep bias=inclination/prejudice and verb bias=influence/skew, plus low textile bias. Add academic/research bias=systematic deviation/error introduced by sampling, measurement, design, analysis or other processes. Current bias↔prejudice relation is acceptable and should remain as a probabilistic overlap/contrast, not exact synonymy.

relation_truth.target_truth: Semantic overlap is real, but 'interchangeable' is too absolute; encode discourse/position differences and use probabilistic contrast.
Keep the distinction that bias is a broader inclination/skew, conscious or unconscious, while prejudice is usually a pre-judged unfair/negative attitude, often toward people/groups.

notes: Truth-stage artifact only: no Word or Relation semantics were mutated.
